acceptance.given: A Matrix Contract identifies one or more unaffected cases, each with its frozen expectation, distinct fixture or state transition, and attributed Stable and Candidate execution receipts.

oracle.expected: For every unaffected Matrix Case, both real subject executions demonstrate the case's frozen preserved behavior; neither missing evidence nor a regression is accepted as success.
forbidden: An unaffected Matrix Case is treated as successful without demonstrating preserved behavior.
A regression in an unaffected Matrix Case is accepted.
oracle.observable: The replay-matrix result contains per-unaffected-case Stable and Candidate execution observations bound to the case fixture/state and frozen expectation, with preserved behavior confirmed for each case.

acceptance.then: The unaffected Matrix Cases have demonstrated preserved behavior.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute an unaffected Matrix Case with one subject's observed behavior deliberately differing from its frozen preserved expectation; require a non-success case result and no accepted aggregate result.
Execute an unaffected Matrix Case with either the Stable or Candidate preservation observation absent; require rejection rather than a successful unaffected-case classification.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require scripts/sc/skill_package_replay.py to evaluate each Matrix Contract case designated unaffected from its real Stable and Candidate executions, binding both observations to that case's distinct fixture or state transition and frozen expectation; classify the case as preserved only when both observations demonstrate that expectation, and reject missing proof or a regression.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the existing replay-matrix receipt and terminal-category compatibility; rollback only the per-unaffected-case preservation gate and do not reinterpret missing or regressed execution evidence as successful.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unaffected Matrix Case results without demonstrated preserved behavior -> per-case Stable and Candidate observations bound to the frozen expectation -> preserved result only when both observations satisfy that expectation; otherwise non-success.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every unaffected Matrix Case has attributable real Stable and Candidate execution observations for its frozen fixture/state and expectation, both demonstrate preserved behavior, and no missing observation or regression is classified as success.
